windows_backend.scope: Windows staging, actual local source backend and hash-verified artifact receipt. No installed-executable claim.

independent_audit.scope: Independent Decimal readback of unfiltered native A/K/area/perimeter and exact every-mask GDS/OASIS/private-stream XOR. No production conversion/comparison function used.

initial_audit_failure.observed: The recursive-iterator Region returned from a helper became empty after the helper's layout/cell objects went out of scope. Native and application results were not changed.
initial_audit_failure.correction: Materialize polygon-only Regions and retain the source Layout objects throughout comparison. Recheck all 24 native junctions and all 648 mask pairs.

comparison: Native A/P and A/K are checked against independent masks/metal before converting SI units to the public X model. Final one-device comparator admits no unexamined directives, devices or parameters; this is not general multi-device LVS.
